caption: The drawing depicts the corner of a room with cream-colored walls and orange-brown wood trim. The trim includes a horizontal strip running along the top edge of the wall and another strip about halfway up the wall, both continuing around the corner. At the base of the walls, there is a wider orange-brown wooden baseboard trim. In the corner is a built-in, vertically-oriented wooden cabinet that is also orange-brown in color. The cabinet has a tall door at the top with two recessed panels, a small round knob, and extends downward to two smaller drawers, each with a central round knob. The floor is gray, and the entire composition is centered within a beige or light tan rectangular background. There are no additional objects or decorations present in the scene.
title: Shaker Built-In Cupboard
